description: Manual spin breaker. `lock` runs a 3-element pre-flight lock (target surface, observable check, forbidden boundary) before edits or delegation; default `rescue` halts loops, parks side quests and 4-line restart breadcrumbs, and proposes one discriminating read-only probe; `map` renders a static HTML decision board. Use spec-convergence for full spec design, ce-debug for root-cause debugging.
